claims: Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is offered on Friday, March 13, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM local time.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is available at all Chipotle locations in the U.S. and Canada.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is in-restaurant only.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO requires a purchased entree.
Any visible tattoo—permanent, temporary, or drawn-on with a marker—qualifies a customer for Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is buy one regular-priced entree (burrito, bowl, salad, or tacos) and get a second one of equal or lesser value for free.
The maximum number of free items per check for Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is 5.
Kids' meals are not included as a qualifying entree for Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO is inspired by the "tatted like a Chipotle bag" internet meme.
Chipotle's "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO features a partnership with musician Swae Lee.
